items.title: 酒友与老管家 · 修订版
items.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing pixel character concept sheet. Preserve composition, two large characters and four expression head studies, dark brown backdrop, Chinese names, character identities, natural adult proportions, SAME visible pixel clusters and matte limited colors. Make only requested changes:
1 LEFT 那位客人: change the BLUE cocktail in his coupe into a pale translucent celadon/lime GREEN classic Last Word cocktail, not neon or glowing. Keep the same glass silhouette, volume, hand, face, paper, jacket and seated posture.
2 RIGHT 老管家: add modest thin dark bronze round reading glasses to his face and BOTH corresponding lower expression studies. Pixel-art glasses, simple stepped pixel curves, lenses completely clear with no glare hiding eyes. Make his expression kindlier: softer relaxed eyebrows, warm attentive eyes and gentle closed-mouth smile, slightly softer cheek lines. Keep elderly age silver hair, clean-shaven slim face, blue waistcoat ledger and keys. Not exaggerated jolly cartoon, not young. In lower heads show kindly attentive and warmly smiling. Everything remains crisp pixel art, NO smooth eye detail, no blur, no anti-aliased vector glasses, no highlights. Do not add any other character or decoration.

items.title: 投递员与调酒师 · 修订版
items.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Revise this pixel character sheet into TWO-character landscape concept board, with only the courier and bartender. REMOVE the leftmost protagonist completely and REMOVE the rightmost white-haired merchant completely; no blank silhouette placeholders. Recenter the remaining two in generous space at equal adult scale from head to upper thigh, simple dark brown backdrop matching source. Labels below: 投递员 on left, 调酒师 on right. Keep same sharp visible pixel grid / refined large clusters, adult proportions, matte material and restrained colors. NO smooth painting, no chibi.
LEFT courier: preserve the source's second character closely, navy cap and jacket, rust neckerchief, chestnut short hair, canvas mailbag, clipboard and pencil. Eye area naturally hidden by cap, friendly quiet lower face. Keep outfit pose colors and design.
RIGHT bartender: redesign source third character to look elegant, composed and welcoming instead of depressed and gloomy. Adult male ~38, clean shaven, tidy dark hair neatly swept to side rather than long hanging fringe. Upright relaxed shoulders, straight graceful posture, head only slightly turned down toward glass. Ivory rolled-sleeve crisp shirt, tailored muted charcoal/navy waistcoat, modest brown waist apron. One hand delicately supports stem of a coupe glass, other polishes with clean cream cloth, anatomically coherent hands. Small natural pleasant closed-mouth smile. Eye details should STILL be understated/non-identifiable per user: no bright pupils or white eyes, only tiny low-contrast warm skin-tone pixel hints partly hidden by angled head/brow. Crucially NO black band covering upper face, no heavy dark shadow mask, no horror facelessness, no hair covering entire face, no dour expression. Face lit gently in same matte warm tones as hands, faint eyes blend into adjacent skin shadows. Elegant professional bartender, not a mysterious villain or tuxedo prince. Clean limited pixel ramps with no oily highlight. Preserve source pixel style and overall modest workwear mood.

scope: 7 new NPCs; protagonist cancelled; existing merchant unchanged
